sdk_request_and_stream_retries.transient_rate_limits: native implementation; ProContract retains original-allocation wait, stock binary unchanged

storage_policy: Only this study: after grading and confirmed solver exit, lossless tar.zst archive verified against original files before removing their uncompressed copies. Keep submission, evaluation, counters and metadata online. Low free space pauses new admission; existing allocations are not renewed.
preparation_policy: Fixed image digests and official test archives; exact collection and native image probes before each task admission. Preparatory failures remain listed and do not spend a solve or select a replacement.
comparison_scope: Full200 GPT-6-Luna/max ProContract and unmodified stock Codex0.167.0 with goal; paired fresh workspaces, shared process-limit transport and same grader profile. No RSI candidate activation during collection.
remaining_harness_limitations: Selector interruption and controller process loss do not have autonomous wake recovery; these failures are retained as outcomes, not hidden by rerunning solvers.
preparation_qualification: Each case must pass exact official collection and native image probe before its first solver allocation.
grader_change: Exact pinned image config and RootFS imported to qualified grader daemon; compilation offline and testing on procontract-grader-calibration-20261105. Unchanged official tests, retries, xdist and scorer.
score_projection: Retain pinned scorer value, eligible identity, execution completeness and infrastructure errors separately. First protocol-ordered bound usable scorer value; never select by highest score.
scheduler_policy: Shared16 admission capacity with existing Sol campaign; no allocation renewal. Preparation has no model calls.
model_identity_policy: Every request pins gpt-6-luna/max; actual response identities are retained and validated. Explicit model_context_window=1050000 for the root agent, native role context policies retained. No substitution.
operator_exposure: ProContract uses the retained strategy informed by earlier full200 trajectories; this reused benchmark measures the requested system comparison. Neither arm receives prior implementations, hidden tests/results, or Vals trajectories as solver input.
native_process_limit_adapter: Common JSON-RPC process/terminate adapter; no changed tool argv or result; 180 seconds from process admission.

qualification.scope: Actual GPT-6-Luna/max root and workers, offline UID1000 tool execution, issued contract, artifact capture/publication and independent review. Not a claim of native settlement or internal Support.
